note: UPPER BOUNDS — these are vectorized results from Binance 1m candle data, NOT from Polymarket trade flow. Basis risk vs Chainlink oracle not accounted for.

gbm_calibration.notes: Slope 0.94 is close to 1.0. GBM slightly over-weights current move (mild mean-reversion bias), but not exploitable in isolation. At t=2 min, buckets are well-calibrated across all return levels — no systematic GBM mispricing.

feature_significance.key_finding: Prior 5-min momentum is by far the strongest predictor. Top Q (positive momentum) achieves 58.8% UP accuracy. Bottom Q (negative momentum) achieves 56.7% DOWN accuracy. Both exceed the 53% profitability threshold.

top_conditions.notes: Q4 of prior 5m return: return > +0.09%. Extremely significant (chi2=107.67, p<0.001).
Combining top-Q taker buy ratio AND top-Q 5m momentum. Smaller universe but concentrated signal.
Symmetric DN signal. Buy NO when prior momentum negative AND low taker pressure.
High volume spike + negative 5m momentum. Smaller n but good hit rate.
Q1 of prior 5m return: return < -0.08%. Strong momentum continuation in both directions.

caveats: Binance candles ≠ Chainlink oracle — basis risk unquantified

gbm_vs_reality.verdict: GBM IS WELL-CALIBRATED at t=2 min
gbm_vs_reality.key_finding: No bucket shows >5pp GBM mispricing. Actual outcomes closely match GBM predictions across all return levels. Brier skill score of 0.217 means GBM explains ~22% of outcome variance (good for 5-min prediction).
gbm_vs_reality.implication: If Polymarket market makers use GBM pricing, there is NO systematic mispricing from the GBM model itself. Alpha must come from MOMENTUM persistence, not from GBM model error.
gbm_vs_reality.slope_interpretation: slope=0.94 suggests very mild mean-reversion (GBM slightly over-predicts extreme outcomes). Not exploitable standalone.

sell_dual_test.reason: This is a pure price-prediction hypothesis, not a copy-trade hypothesis. No SELL/BUY distinction applies. Signal is directional (BUY UP or BUY DN market contracts) based on momentum features.

knowledge_captures.finding: 5-min BTC Up/Down is nearly 50/50 (50.68% Up over 30 days). Do not assume 62% NO base rate for crypto scalp markets — that applies only to non-crypto Polymarket yes/no markets.

Standard GBM (zero drift, 30m realized vol) is well-calibrated for 5-min BTC outcomes (slope=0.94, BSS=0.217). No systematic GBM mispricing found. Alpha must come from momentum persistence, not from model error.

Prior 5-min BTC return strongly predicts next 5-min direction (chi2=107.67, p<0.001). Top quartile momentum achieves 58.8% directional accuracy — well above 53% fee threshold. This is a textbook short-term momentum effect.
